info.title: Honua Server Management API
info.description: Curated OpenAPI snapshot of key Honua Server administrative endpoints for configuration, import scanning, connections, layers, styles, observability, realtime alert management, durable job viewing, disconnected replica conflict review, package validation and preview planning, runtime licensing, deploy control, and native client-certificate trust management. For full runtime endpoint discovery, use /api/v1/admin/config and the Control Plane guide.

x-honua-client-certificate-auth.note: OpenAPI 3.0 cannot directly model TLS client-certificate presentation. Required admin/native mTLS modes are enforced before normal RBAC and return application/problem+json with stable client_certificate_* codes.

get.description: Get the canonical MapLibre style document for a layer plus revision metadata (styleVersion, revisedAt, revisedBy, changeSummary). The cached drawingInfo conversion is included when available.

put.description: Update the canonical MapLibre style for a layer. Supply mapLibreStyle directly or a GeoServices drawingInfo payload that the engine converts. Optional changedBy and changeSummary populate the layer's revision metadata; changeSummary longer than 1000 characters returns 400. The response includes the persisted style, the incremented styleVersion, the new revisedAt timestamp, and unsupportedSymbolizers[] entries with stable StyleErrorCodes for any symbolizers that could not be losslessly translated. Style intent is never silently dropped: a best-effort MapLibre fallback is still returned alongside the unsupported list.

post.description: Convert an SLD/SE 1.0 or 1.1 XML document to a MapLibre style and persist it as the layer's stored style. Admin-only; available in Community edition (no FeatureCatalog gate). Body is the raw SLD document (capped at 1 MiB; oversized requests return 413). Conversion warnings come back in the success body's diagnostics array; error-severity diagnostics return 422 with the same diagnostic shape under data.diagnostics.

200.description: Imported and stored MapLibre style with conversion diagnostics

413.description: SLD body exceeds the 1 MiB limit

422.description: SLD conversion produced error-severity diagnostics; nothing stored

get.description: Export the layer's stored MapLibre style as SLD 1.0 XML on a best-effort basis. The X-Sld-Diagnostic-Count response header reports how many constructs surfaced during export; X-Sld-Diagnostics carries the JSON-encoded diagnostic array when the count is non-zero. A 422 with data.diagnostics is returned when no MapLibre layer can be expressed in SLD.

X-Sld-Diagnostic-Count.description: Number of conversion diagnostics emitted during export.

X-Sld-Diagnostics.description: JSON-encoded array of SldConversionDiagnostic entries; only present when X-Sld-Diagnostic-Count > 0.

422.description: Stored MapLibre style cannot be expressed as SLD; see diagnostics

post.description: Generate an advisory style suggestion for a layer based on data analysis. Community edition returns enhanced geometry-aware defaults. Pro edition attempts field-based classification with smart palette selection, falling back to enhanced geometry-aware defaults when no suitable classification field is available.

Scan a supported GeoServer REST or ArcGIS GeoServices REST source and return a deterministic migration inventory artifact. The response body is the artifact itself and is not wrapped in a success/data admin envelope. A 200 response can still carry scanCompleteness.status = failed when the scanner produced an artifact but could not complete discovery cleanly. GeoServer uses that failed-artifact path for transport, timeout, auth-related, and other discovery failures; GeoServices also uses it for auth-related and source-reported ArcGIS discovery errors, while transport and timeout failures still surface as 502/504. Pass the export=json query parameter to receive the artifact as an indented JSON attachment suitable for committing to a migration project repository.

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: When set to json, returns the artifact as an indented application/json attachment with Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<service-slug>-inventory.json" and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. The slug is derived from the source displayName, sanitized to [A-Za-z0-9_-], collapsed, and capped at 64 characters; credentials supplied in the request body are never echoed into the artifact.

200.description: Migration source inventory artifact, including partial or failed completeness states when discovery could not finish cleanly. GeoServer can return a failed artifact for transport, timeout, auth-related, or other discovery failures; GeoServices can return a failed artifact for auth-related and source-reported discovery errors, while transport and timeout failures surface as 502/504. With export=json the same artifact is returned as an indented attachment.

502.description: Failed to connect to source service. This is currently surfaced primarily for GeoServices transport failures; GeoServer transport failures return a failed inventory artifact with HTTP 200.

504.description: Source scan timed out. This is currently surfaced primarily for GeoServices timeout failures; GeoServer timeout failures return a failed inventory artifact with HTTP 200.

Bootstrap endpoint for Admin UI and native clients. It does not require API-key, OIDC, or admin-session auth, but required client-certificate prefix enforcement can still apply. Returns OIDC provider labels plus non-secret client-certificate policy hints such as mode, environment id, required surfaces, supported transports, accepted issuer hints, expiration warning threshold, and forwarded-certificate status. Issuer hints are sourced from the live trust store, so admin-API profile create/update/disable mutations are reflected immediately without a restart.

Lists active and disabled client-certificate trust profiles in the in-memory trust store. Configuration-defined profiles are loaded at startup; admin mutations should be mirrored to the deployment source of truth for durable multi-node rollout.

post.description: Creates a client-certificate trust profile. Enabled profiles require at least one accepted issuer subject, accepted issuer thumbprint, or custom trust anchor certificate.

delete.description: Disables a trust profile without deleting its mappings or revocation entries.

post.description: Adds a revocation by SHA-256 fingerprint or by issuer plus serial number.

Validates a supplied public client certificate against configured trust profiles without storing the certificate. A parsed-but-untrusted certificate returns 200 with data.valid=false and a stable data.code; 400 is reserved for missing/blank certificate bodies and unknown encoding values.

200.description: Validation result. A parsed but untrusted certificate returns 200 with data.valid=false and a stable data.code value.

get.description: Returns the SOC 2 / FedRAMP control evidence snapshot: per-control status, dependency-gate evidence rows, encryption posture, and active residency policy.
Renders the current compliance snapshot as a downloadable report. Default format is PDF; pass format=csv for the evidence-matrix CSV.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Report format (pdf or csv). Defaults to pdf when omitted.

406.description: Requested format parses but no renderer is registered for it.

post.description: Dry-runs a region against the active data-residency policy and audit-logs the decision.

200.description: Residency decision and active policy view

post.description: Advances the auditor-facing compliance key-version counter and writes an encryption.key.rotate audit event. This endpoint records the rotation as a compliance event — it does NOT re-encrypt data or rotate the cipher material used by IConnectionEncryptionService (real key-material rotation lives behind Security:ConnectionEncryption:MasterKey). The audit write is decoupled from the caller token so a client disconnect cannot strand a committed posture advance without an audit event.

isActive.description: Whether the rule is active for evaluation.

conditionsJson.description: Rule conditions serialized as a JSON object string.

zone.description: Optional draft zone used to validate enter, exit, and dwell geofence rules without persisting the zone. The draft zone serviceId must match the rule serviceId; if both zone and zoneId are supplied, validation uses the draft zone geometry and returns a warning.

isValid.description: Whether the draft can be persisted safely.

isAllowed.description: Whether the current edition allows the channel.

isConfigured.description: Whether server configuration can deliver the channel.

lastEvaluatedAt.description: Most recent evaluator state update for this rule, when available.

lastTriggeredAt.description: Most recent alert event emitted for this rule, when available.

activeIncidentCount.description: Count of current evaluator state rows that represent active incidents. Enter and dwell rules count features currently inside the zone; threshold rules count currently breached threshold state; exit transition events do not keep an active incident open after the feature has left.

recentTriggerCount.description: Count of alert events for this rule in the previous 24 hours.

coolingDownFeatureCount.description: Count of evaluator state rows currently inside their cooldown window.

nextCooldownExpiresAt.description: Latest cooldown expiry across currently cooling down feature states.

deliveryFailureCount.description: Count of retryable delivery failures for this rule.

deadLetterCount.description: Count of dead-lettered delivery rows for this rule.

linkedEventIds.description: Newest-first recent event identifiers linked to this rule, capped by the server at 10 entries.

recentTriggers.description: Newest-first recent trigger summaries, capped by the server at 10 entries.

status.description: Channel health status. Policy and configuration states take precedence; rate_limited and failing reflect recent delivery errors.

lastError.description: Most recent sanitized delivery error summary. Raw provider error text is not returned.

resourceRef.description: Operate event resource reference, formatted as alert/{eventId}.

manifestDryRunSupported.description: Whether manifest apply dry-run is supported

manifestPruneSupported.description: Whether manifest apply prune is supported

releaseChannel.description: Release channel derived from build metadata

Whether the metadata schema version is deprecated

manifestDryRun.description: Whether manifest apply dry runs are supported

manifestPrune.description: Whether manifest apply prune is supported

CreateConnectionRequest.description: Provide either password or secretReference/secretType. Do not provide both.

changedBy.description: Optional author or source identifier captured for the new revision.

changeSummary.description: Optional operator-supplied description of the change. Longer than 1000 characters returns 400.

status.description: Top-level coordinated deployment status for this instance

readyForCoordinatedDeploy.description: Whether the instance is ready to participate in a coordinated rollout

message.description: Operator-facing summary for the current preflight result

serverVersion.description: Current Honua server version. Only present when includeDiagnostics=true.

environment.description: Current ASP.NET host environment. Only present when includeDiagnostics=true.

deploymentMode.description: Configured Honua deployment mode. Only present when includeDiagnostics=true.

instanceName.description: Machine or instance name serving the request. Only present when includeDiagnostics=true.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the payload was generated

isCompatible.description: Whether the database meets Honua compatibility requirements

postGisRasterVersion.description: PostGIS raster extension version, if installed

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings from the compatibility check

errorMessage.description: Error message when the compatibility check determined incompatibility

isReady.description: Whether the instance is currently ready to accept traffic

statusCode.description: HTTP status code that would be returned by the readiness endpoint

lifecycleStatus.description: Current migration lifecycle status observed by this instance

upgradeRequired.description: Whether pending migration scripts were detected

pendingScripts.description: Migration scripts that would execute if upgrades were applied now

executedButNotDiscoveredScripts.description: Scripts previously executed against the database but no longer discovered by the current binary

planError.description: Error detail when migration planning could not be completed

sourceKind.description: Source kind alias. Accepted values normalize to either geoserver-rest or arcgis-geoservices-rest in the response artifact.

sourceUrl.description: Source URL to scan. GeoServices requires an HTTPS ArcGIS service root ending in FeatureServer or MapServer and rejects layer/table URLs, embedded credentials, plus private, loopback, or unresolvable targets. GeoServer follows the same HTTPS and address-safety rules outside the test-only unsafe local URL mode and also rejects embedded credentials.

username.description: Optional GeoServer basic-auth username. Both username and password are required to send GeoServer basic auth; otherwise the scan proceeds anonymously and records a note. Ignored for GeoServices scans.

password.description: Optional GeoServer basic-auth password. Both username and password are required to send GeoServer basic auth; otherwise the scan proceeds anonymously and records a note. Ignored for GeoServices scans.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional scan timeout in seconds. Defaults to 120 for GeoServer and 30 for GeoServices.

includeStyleContent.description: GeoServer-only. Fetches SLD documents for deeper classification and external graphic detection without returning raw style documents in the artifact.

sourceKind.description: Canonical source kind returned by the scanner.

resources.description: Deterministically ordered layers, tables, or layer groups.

styles.description: Deterministically ordered GeoServer styles or GeoServices renderers.

externalDependencies.description: Deterministically ordered external dependencies with sanitized metadata and normalized external URL addresses.

baseUrl.description: Canonical source URL used for the scan.

serviceType.description: Optional service type or protocol subtype.

mode.description: Observed authentication posture, for example anonymous, basic, auth-required, anonymous-or-auth-required, or unknown. GeoServer scans without a complete username/password pair remain anonymous and add an explanatory note. GeoServices scans run anonymously today; successful artifacts therefore report anonymous, and failed artifacts can report auth-required or unknown when discovery is blocked.

credentialsSupplied.description: Whether the scanner had a complete, usable credential set. GeoServer only sets this to true when both username and password were supplied; partial credentials still fall back to anonymous mode and leave this false. GeoServices scans run anonymously today and leave this false.

accessConfirmed.description: Whether the scan confirmed source access.

notes.description: Additional posture notes, including anonymous-fallback notes when only one GeoServer credential field was supplied.

status.description: Scan completeness classification. failed can still be returned with HTTP 200 when the scanner produced an artifact but could not complete inventory generation cleanly.

missingArtifacts.description: Artifact categories that could not be collected.

code.description: Optional stable machine-readable compatibility code such as COMPATIBLE, MANUAL_REVIEW, ARCGIS_UNSUPPORTED_RENDERER, or ARCGIS_TOKEN_REQUIRED when the scanner can assign one deterministically. Source-specific codes are namespaced per source kind so downstream automation can branch deterministically. Omitted on aggregate assessments where no single code applies and on source-specific assessments that do not yet define a stable code.

reason.description: Primary explanation for the assigned compatibility level.

manualSteps.description: Manual follow-up steps needed for migration.

kind.description: Container kind such as workspace or service.

isDefault.description: Whether the container is the source default.

kind.description: Resource kind such as layer, table, or layer-group.

geometryType.description: Reported geometry type when the resource carries geometry.

hasAttachments.description: Whether the resource advertises attachments. Omitted when the source does not report attachment state.

fields.description: Field schema entries surfaced for the resource when the source advertises one. Sorted alphabetically by name to keep artifacts diff-stable.

styleIds.description: Stable IDs linking this resource to entries in styles[].

externalDependencyIds.description: Stable IDs linking this resource to entries in externalDependencies[].

alias.description: Source-provided display alias when distinct from the field name.

nullable.description: Whether the field is reported nullable. Omitted when the source does not advertise this property (older ArcGIS versions).

domainType.description: Domain category such as codedValue or range when a domain is attached.

domainName.description: Domain name for the attached domain.

domainValues.description: Coded values for codedValue domains. Bounded; coded-value domains exceeding the cap surface as the ARCGIS_DOMAIN_TRUNCATED warning rather than silent truncation.

code.description: Coded value as advertised by the source.

name.description: Display name for the coded value.

kind.description: Style kind such as style or renderer.

resourceIds.description: Stable IDs linking this style or renderer to entries in resources[].

externalDependencyIds.description: Stable IDs linking this style or renderer to entries in externalDependencies[].

metadata.description: Deterministic planning metadata for the style or renderer. Does not include raw GeoServer SLD bodies.

kind.description: Dependency kind such as datastore, coverage-store, attachments, external-graphic, or external-symbol.

address.description: Dependency address or endpoint when available. External URLs omit embedded credentials, query strings, and fragments.

metadata.description: Deterministic dependency metadata with sensitive values redacted when applicable.

sourceValue.description: Source-provided CRS identifier or text. ArcGIS WKID values remain in source form when the scanner cannot confirm EPSG authority.

credentialReference.description: Secret manager reference (when using external credentials)

isPrimaryKey.description: Whether this is a primary key column

UnsupportedSymbolizerInfo.description: Describes a single symbolizer input that the style engine could not translate to the canonical MapLibre Style Spec v8 form.

layerCount.description: Number of MapLibre layers produced by the conversion.

SldImportFailureResponse.description: Failure payload for SLD import (422) and SLD export (422). Carries the diagnostic list that explains why the request was refused.

detectedVersion.description: Detected SLD version (when parsing succeeded but conversion failed). Null on the export path.

severity.description: Warning entries are informational and the import still succeeds. Error entries cause the import or export to fail with 422.

construct.description: Construct that triggered the diagnostic (e.g. VendorOption, ExternalGraphic, OgcFunction, PropertyIsLike).

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Never includes raw exception messages or filesystem paths.

ruleName.description: Optional rule name when the diagnostic was emitted while processing a specific SLD Rule.

mergeStrategy.description: Canonical merge strategy applied when a layer's mosaic produces overlapping pixels. Always one of the canonical lowercase tokens or null when unset.

Merge strategy applied when overlapping rasters mosaic together. Allowed values (case-insensitive): newest, oldest, average, max, min. Stored values are normalized to lowercase. An empty string clears the field. Unknown values are rejected with 400 Bad Request.

metadataApiVersion.description: Metadata API version supported by the server

oidcEnabled.description: Whether at least one configured OIDC provider is available for admin login.

providers.description: Client-safe OIDC provider labels. Authority, tenant, client id, and secrets are never returned.

key.description: Provider selection key such as azuread, google, oidc, okta, or auth0.

displayName.description: Provider display name shown to operators.

environmentId.description: Server environment id used for trust-profile matching.

requiredForAdmin.description: Whether configured admin path prefixes require a valid mapped client certificate.

requiredForNative.description: Whether configured native gRPC services require a valid mapped client certificate.

supportedTransports.description: Transports that can satisfy native client-certificate authentication. Empty when mode is Disabled.

acceptedIssuerSubjects.description: Issuer subject hints from enabled profiles for this environment, returned in the canonicalized form (uppercase, no internal whitespace) used for certificate matching.

acceptedIssuerThumbprints.description: Issuer thumbprint hints from enabled profiles for this environment, returned in the canonicalized form (uppercase, no internal whitespace) used for certificate matching.

expirationWarningThresholdDays.description: Minimum warning threshold across enabled profiles for this environment, or null when none are enabled.

forwardedCertificateEnabled.description: Whether trusted forwarded client-certificate headers are enabled.

profileId.description: Optional trust profile id for create requests.

environmentId.description: Honua environment id this profile applies to.

acceptedIssuerThumbprints.description: SHA-1 thumbprints of accepted issuer/CA certificates (leaf thumbprints are not honored). Matching is gated by cryptographic chain build, so the issuing CA must be reachable through the OS trust store or the profile's customTrustAnchorCertificates; a thumbprint that only appears in a forged leaf's attached chain will not match.

requireChainTrust.description: Required to be true when acceptedIssuerSubjects is non-empty; subject-DN matching alone is forgeable, so the chain must be cryptographically verified. Thumbprint and custom-anchor profiles already perform cryptographic chain build during the issuer-hint check; enabling requireChainTrust additionally applies the configured chainRevocationMode (Online/Offline).

customTrustAnchorCertificates.description: Custom trust anchor public certificates as PEM or base64 DER. Private keys are never accepted. The presented chain must build successfully under custom-root trust mode and terminate at one of these anchors; cryptographic chain verification is enforced regardless of requireChainTrust.

mappingId.description: Optional mapping id for create requests.

revocationId.description: Optional revocation id for idempotent automation.

issuer.description: Revoked issuer distinguished name, used with serialNumber.

serialNumber.description: Revoked certificate serial number, used with issuer.

certificate.description: PEM, URL-encoded PEM, or base64 DER public client certificate.

apiVersion.description: API version of the manifest payload

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the manifest was generated

driftedResources.description: Resource identifiers that have drifted since the last applied manifest

manifestHash.description: Hash of the manifest content for change detection

dryRun.description: When true, no changes are persisted

prune.description: When true, resources not present in the manifest are removed

dryRun.description: Whether the apply was a dry run

MetadataPrevalidateRequest.description: Request body for Metadata v2 release-package compatibility prevalidation. Exactly one of releasePackageId or releasePackage is required.

releasePackageId.description: Persisted MetadataReleasePackage identifier. Must not be an empty GUID.

targetEnvironment.description: Target environment whose current Metadata v2 graph snapshot is compared. The value is trimmed and must not be blank.

dataScripts.description: Optional declared data script contracts. Omit for no scripts; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected. Prevalidation analyzes these declarations but never executes scripts.

canCreatePullRequest.description: False for blocked and unknown reports; true for ready and warning reports.

canPromote.description: False for blocked and unknown reports; true for ready and warning reports.

targetEnvironment.description: Optional target environment for this script. Omitted or blank applies to every target; populated values are trimmed and matched case-insensitively.

beforeContract.description: Declared pre-script state. Omit when not known; child collection arrays may be omitted but explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

afterContract.description: Declared post-script state. Omit when no script coverage is claimed. Missing-artifact coverage requires expected discriminator/detail fields, not only exists=true.

declaredOperations.description: Optional operation labels. Omit for no labels; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

resources.description: Semantic artifact contracts. Omit for an empty contract; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

MetadataScriptResourceContract.description: Semantic artifact contract used by data-script before/after coverage. For missing artifacts, exists=true alone is not sufficient; include expected resourceType, serviceType/route/protocols, publication identity/details, or storage binding details as applicable.

fields.description: Fields expected before or after the script. Omit for no fields; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

requiredIdentifiers.description: Required field identifiers expected before or after the script. Omit for none; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

domains.description: Canonical domain identifiers expected before or after the script. Omit for none; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

indexes.description: Canonical index identifiers expected before or after the script. Omit for none; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

capabilities.description: Service or publication capabilities expected before or after the script. Omit for none; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

supportedFormats.description: Publication formats expected before or after the script. Omit for none; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

semanticRoles.description: Semantic roles expected on the field. Omit for none; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

domains.description: Canonical domain identifiers expected on the field. Omit for none; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

indexes.description: Canonical index identifiers expected on the field. Omit for none; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

capabilities.description: Storage binding capabilities. Omit for none; explicit null arrays or entries are rejected.

apiVersion.description: API version of the resource schema

kind.description: Resource kind (Service, Layer, Relationship, Style, Connection)

spec.description: Desired state specification (schema varies by kind)

idempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key to prevent duplicates

submitImmediately.description: Whether to submit the operation immediately after creation

isReady.description: Whether the instance is ready for traffic

isFailed.description: Whether migration lifecycle state is failed

planAvailable.description: Whether a migration plan could be generated

pendingScripts.description: Migration scripts that would run if upgrades were applied

executedButNotDiscoveredScripts.description: Scripts previously executed but no longer discovered by current binary

planError.description: Error detail when plan generation failed

repositoryUrl.description: Git repository URL (HTTPS, SSH, or git protocol)

manifestPath.description: Relative exact manifest file path or directory path. Directory paths resolve to honua-manifest.json first, then manifest.json; slashless paths without a file extension are normalized as directories. Glob patterns are not supported.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Poll interval in seconds (floored to server-configured minimum)

approvalRequired.description: Whether changes require approval before applying

pruneEnabled.description: Whether to delete server resources absent from the repository manifest

enabled.description: Whether the watch should be active

manifestPath.description: Configured relative exact manifest file path or directory path

before.description: Manifest state before the change (null for first apply)

expiresAt.description: License expiry timestamp, or null for Community/perpetual licenses.

isValid.description: Whether the active configured license validated successfully.

daysUntilExpiry.description: Ceiling day count until expiresAt, or null when no expiry is present.

expiryWarning.description: True when daysUntilExpiry is within Licensing:ExpiryWarningDays.

validationState.description: Runtime validation state for the active license snapshot.

entitlements.description: Known FeatureCatalog entitlement inventory with active/inactive state.

isActive.description: Whether this entitlement is active in the current snapshot.

isEnabled.description: Whether the feature is enabled by the active license snapshot.

minimumEdition.description: Minimum catalog edition for this feature.

upgradeRequired.description: True when the current snapshot does not activate this feature.

success.description: Whether the upload was accepted and applied.

message.description: Sanitized upload result or rejection message.

isEnabled.description: Whether the feature is enabled by the active license snapshot.

upgradeMessage.description: Upgrade hint when the feature is inactive.

StyleSuggestionRequest.description: Optional overrides for style suggestion generation.

preferredField.description: Use this field for classification instead of auto-selection. If the field does not exist or is not eligible (e.g. geometry, binary, boolean), the server falls back to geometry-only defaults and includes the reason in the observations array.

preferredMethod.description: Classification method override. Supported values: EqualInterval, Quantile, NaturalBreaks, UniqueValue. Unrecognized values are ignored and the server auto-selects.

preferredPalette.description: Palette name override. Supported values: Viridis, CartoBold, RdBu. Unrecognized values are ignored and the server auto-selects.

classCount.description: Number of classes to generate (default 5). Clamped to the range 2-12.

StyleSuggestionResponse.description: Advisory style suggestion for a layer.

mapLibreStyle.description: MapLibre v8 style document (ready to apply).

classificationMethod.description: Classification method used (null for geometry-only defaults).

paletteName.description: Name of the color palette used.

source.description: Where the evidence was collected from (dependency-gate, encryption-posture, residency-policy, configuration).

region.description: Region code to evaluate against the active policy.

contractVersion.description: Package-review contract version. The current supported value is honua.package_review.v1.

packageFamily.description: Supported values are query, analysis_plan, map_package, dashboard_report, form, app_package, workflow, gp, and etl. packageFamily is not required and not enum-limited: a missing value returns a missing_package_family finding and an unknown value returns an unsupported_package_family finding, rather than an HTTP validation error.

requestedAction.description: Caller-requested action being reviewed, for example execute or publish.

packagePayload.description: Opaque package payload. analysis_plan and gp payloads are parsed as analysis-plan candidates.

requirements.description: Shared validation requirements. An explicit null is normalized to an empty requirement set.

includePreviewPlan.description: Caller preference. /packages/validate forces false and /packages/preview forces true.

resourceRefs.description: Safe caller-visible resource references. An explicit null is normalized to an empty map.

packageFamily.description: Echoes the reviewed package family. Unknown values can appear in blocked reviews.

mayMutatePublishedState.description: Must remain false for preview responses.
Must remain false for preview responses.
